description: Pinned results of Stage 2 of the DynamicUSP solver for the dynamic_usp scheduler type. The section plans comes from an offline run of the upstream solver at commit 1ff97a4ae0beb5e088fadb9e112265bdd194b24d: it is solver output, not a measurement, and the runtime scheduler must reproduce it. The section runtime is not upstream output. Times are milliseconds.

cases.name: compute_lpt
cases.note: a microbatch re-packed from the compute_lpt queue; the step time falls

cases.name: memory_lpt
cases.note: a microbatch re-packed from the memory_lpt queue

cases.name: step_time_rises
cases.note: the slowest group of a microbatch gets faster and the step time rises: upstream's rule looks at one microbatch

cases.name: nothing_adopted
cases.note: no microbatch is re-packed; the plan is the Stage 1 layout

cases.name: keep_threshold
cases.note: keep_threshold 1.0: the result differs from the one with 8.4 on the same batch (next case)

cases.name: keep_threshold_default
cases.note: the batch of the previous case with keep_threshold 8.4

cases.name: pipeline_2
cases.note: two pipeline stages, 1 virtual stage(s) per stage: the count is a multiple of two and both step times are those of the interleaved pipeline schedule

cases.name: unaligned_compute_lpt
cases.note: lengths that are not multiples of 2 x DPxCP, through the split feed: upstream's engine with tokens = padded lengths (token cap, memory queue) and a profile pricing the logical lengths; with the logical lengths as tokens the result differs

cases.name: unaligned_memory_lpt
cases.note: lengths that are not multiples of 2 x DPxCP, through the split feed: upstream's engine with tokens = padded lengths (token cap, memory queue) and a profile pricing the logical lengths; with the logical lengths as tokens the result differs

plans.description: Whole plans at DPxCP 32 from upstream solve_gbs with Stage2Policy(enabled=True, profile_name='usp_calib_v1', on_error='fallback', keep_threshold as given), the packaged table, PipelineCostModel(profile, pipeline_parallel, virtual_stages) and GbsConfig(pp_multiple=pipeline_parallel). The ring guard of the upstream profile is neutralised: guard_margin_for_group returns the finite margin 1e30, which passes every test, so the pins are those of a Stage 2 without guard. Unaligned cases use the split feed: Sample.tokens is the length padded to a multiple of 64 and the profile prices the logical length. Objective values are upstream's step time without the global constant; stage2 holds the outcome (code) of every microbatch of the chosen count; layout is [[[first rank, group size, [sample index, ...]], ...] per microbatch] after Stage 2, samples in the order upstream returns them.

cases.name: blocks_every_candidate
cases.note: the guard blocks every construction of a microbatch that Stage 2 without the guard re-packs: NO_VALID_CANDIDATE where Stage 2 without the guard has ADOPTED

cases.name: changes_adopted_layout
cases.note: a microbatch is re-packed with and without the guard, into different layouts

cases.name: unaligned
cases.note: lengths that are not multiples of 2 x DPxCP, through the split feed (Sample.tokens = padded length; costs and the guard margin from the logical length): the guard changes the outcome

ring_guard_plans.description: Whole plans at DPxCP 32 from UNMODIFIED upstream solve_gbs with Stage2Policy(enabled=True, profile_name='usp_calib_v1', on_error='fallback', keep_threshold as given) and the packaged table: upstream's real ring guard. Fields as in the plans section. In every case the guard changes the outcome of a microbatch, against upstream's result on the same Stage 1 layout with the guard neutralised.

ring_guard_shipped.description: The inputs of the sections plans and runtime, which hold results WITHOUT the ring guard, through UNMODIFIED upstream WITH its ring guard (solve_gbs, Stage2Policy(enabled=True), the packaged table). For every case of the plans section upstream with its guard gives the pinned result as well: both objectives, the outcome of every microbatch and the layout are identical. The case sequence_limit of the runtime section is the runtime's own (upstream has no sequence limit); the runtime with the guard of the original profile gives the pinned result, upstream's Stage 2 with its guard on the Stage 1 layout of the runtime gives the pinned outcome and layout of the microbatches 0, 2 and 4, and the others, 1 and 3, are those in which the capacity predicate of the runtime rejected a placement. keep_rule_tie: eight samples of one length (each of lengths) in one group of 32 ranks at keep_threshold 4: codes is the outcome of the one microbatch from upstream with its guard, on python3.11 and on Python 3.12 (without the guard the two interpreters decide differently).

runtime.description: NOT upstream output: the runtime's own result where its capacity predicate acts inside Stage 2. The per-group sequence limit rejects placements that the token cap admits (runtime_capacity true in the records of the statistics); upstream has no such limit. Pinned: the full layout and the Stage 2 statistics of the plan as the runtime gives them: counts by outcome of every microbatch, and stage2, index (position of the microbatch in the layout) and outcome of the records the statistics keep. sequence_limit is a plan of the original profile without guard, as the plans section.
